items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: I was playing with him at the time. Bonnie, Bonnie Pigar, yeah, him. ... We were playing together.

ctx.x: Who did they have with him?

Who did they have with him then? What he had with him? Yeah. You might know the fellas. I was playing with him at the time. Bonnie, Bonnie Pigar, yeah, him. And his brother, drum, yeah. We were playing together. Alex. Yeah. And then Charlie, Charlie Decanje, he was blowing trumpets. He's up there. Real light fella. Yeah, he's up there, but he don't play. He's a policeman up there now. Where? Where's the policeman at? I believe in Chicago. And, uh, what's the other fella named? Bill Matthews, he was playing drums.…
